tagline: View photo EXIF metadata and remove GPS and camera data for privacy
pageDescription: View and remove EXIF metadata from your photos with this free online EXIF Viewer & Remover. Drop a JPG, PNG, HEIC or TIFF to reveal the hidden data your camera embedded — make and model, exposure settings, capture date and the exact GPS location — then strip all of it with one click and download a clean copy. Everything runs locally in your browser, so your photos and their location are never uploaded. Essential before sharing images online, posting to forums or selling items, when leaked GPS coordinates can expose your home address.

instructions.title: How to view and remove EXIF data

steps.title: Upload a photo
steps.description: Drag and drop a photo or click to browse. JPG, PNG, HEIC and TIFF all carry EXIF metadata.

steps.title: Review the metadata
steps.description: The hidden data is grouped into Camera, Exposure, Date and Location sections so you can see exactly what's embedded.

steps.title: Check the location warning
steps.description: If GPS coordinates are present, a warning appears with a map link showing precisely where the photo was taken.

steps.title: Remove all metadata
steps.description: Click Remove all metadata. The image is re-encoded in your browser, dropping every EXIF, GPS and camera tag.

steps.title: Download the clean photo
steps.description: Download the cleaned copy. It looks identical but carries no hidden data to share by mistake.
